name: suede-marketing-council
description: Suede AI marketing council: twelve role-based simulated advisors (Positioning Strategist, Offer Strategist, Search Visibility Strategist, Brand Reach Scientist, and others) apply named Suede frameworks to one bounded marketing decision, map the disagreements and the evidence that would settle each, and return a chair's synthesis with next steps and skill handoffs. Use when the user wants expert lenses, a simulated advisory board, a pressure test of a contested or irreversible bet, or a skeptic's
author: JasonColapietro
